svg.text: The Ankama title language — scrolls, leaves, inked gold — plus a retro mood and the membership ladder in forged metals.
Stacked DOFUS / FORGE with an Ankama
scroll divider and a faceted ◆ heart.
Hero title for home, OG and splash.
Wooden plaque, brass rivets and a
Iron, bronze, silver and gold shields:
each tier forges one step further,
up to the glowing Master Dofus.
Proposal: A becomes the hero title of the system; B is an optional seasonal theme; C ships with memberships.
